- Fix Apple ID sign-in crash caused by a widget bundle ID.
- Merge pull request #36 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- fix: should use session level delegate instead of task level delegate
- fixes for markdown rendering in protcol mismatch vs preferred
- cleanup + remprompt when loaded pairing isnt the one that is preferred + fixes for clearing

- split into view + vm
- cleanup
- cleanup: move name to separate row
- reaname pairing file names to be of same length
- fix: centralize pairing managment stuff into pairing file manager
- cleanup move the supported pairing types into manager
- cleanup: move deeplink handling into own files
- implement dual pairing file support
- move things around - restructure
- updated minimuxer error handling
- fix: updated pairing error message to reflect proper solution
- fix: updated pairing error message to reflect proper solution
- cleanup old stuff
- added toggle to enable minimuxer backed hotswap in developer options
- developer-option: dump profiles as zip
- fetchUDID is now throwing if cannot fetch
- cleanup of wrapper to reflect latest Minimuxer API changes
- sidebackup: updated message to reflect current action items possible
- cleanup - remove old stuff
- restore resign option and keep reinstall as explicit submenu item
- moved pairing managment into own row "Pairing File Management"
- refine wireless pairing pin view with .sheet
- fixes for wireless pairing (bumped idevice to v0.1.68)
- fix: sidejit server wasn't detecting server disabled and was showing "resolving..."
- promote "network discovery" from experimental features into advanced settings
- implement zip backup export/import in addition to raw
- fix cache management to reflect new cache structure
- removed fallback db creation when appgroup is inaccessible and show error
- updated package.resolved to latest
- handle db downgrades gracefully with a clear message to user
- added auto-launch after finish of install
- added capability to clear customizations when app is detected as uninstalled or is being uninstalled
- added install confirmation prompt to all possible screens from which install can be triggered including sources
- added install confirmation settings in user customization
- switch to reinstall instead of resign coz we now support reinstall from cache (ie resign) + reinstall from source
- added option to use a default mode ie file picker vs url vs prompt user
- added custom filtering for resolveFirstService in bonjour manager
- maintenance: added another force clearing of headers to prevent 503
- gate auto retried port caching for rppairing in userdefault
- stop bg services before we do self-reinstall to prevent hang coz our process is still alive
- cache the last discovered rppairing port to use as initial seed in next boot
- handle only few errors related to nodevice, notReachable for retrying + add it to fetchUDID
- updated submodules to latest
- Merge pull request #35 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- chore(version): bump to 0.7.3
- Merge pull request #34 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- fix: sidebackup install was dropping host app extensions entries in installedapp during installappoperation
- updated appExtensions to use targetAppBundle.appExtensions directly since RemoveAppExtensionsOperation runs just before and removes unselected extensions from disk
- migrate the cached signing_cert too
- cleanup alt* keys from info plist including appgroups and replace appgroup lookup with machoparser to read from machO header quickly for active appgroup entilements as ground truth
- cleanup legacy stuff
- added pre db startup maintenence + cleanup by moving to sidestore convention
- added auto migration of cached app to new format
- missed adding info.plist changes in last commit for bg location services
- added bg processing modes thru audio and location with choices
- updated minimuxer for on-device JIT support
- fixes for enableJIT notifications - prefer notif and fallback to toast if not avail
- promote cell refresh into user customizations now that it is stable
- fix: added safeXXX minimuxer methods so that pre-req missing are handled properly
- fix: added definitive waits for minimuxer to be ready upon cell shortcuts refresh
- wg-cell-refresh-update: oops seems apple-wg-client drops connection if wifi or cell is not active on ios but supports without discrimination on macos - a bummer, so will show error message when trying to do cell refresh and is on wg mode
- updated to latest
- added diag logging
- updated submodules to latest
- fix: since wg is server connection is on-demand and keep-alive is 25 sec, we need to self probe wg client to trigger (ready!!) binding to our emp server from the client before confirming start() is complete
- cleanup: fix warning
- skip reconcileInstalledApps if we are in middle of active managing of an app - prevents cleanup of bundle when we use cell refresh and we open shortcuts and jump back and forth ie bg fg switching
- fix: process from appex from installedApp first if present
- relax base delay for tunOnData to 1.0 so that it completes switching
- restrict batched updates for profiles only when on cellular
- use dialog for edits
- use dialog for edits
- reduce progress to 85% when in batch so that rest is taken care by the batch installer
- ensure edits for the time delay doesn't accept invalid inputs
- cleanup ie remove the empty fallback and use default values
- feature: support group cell refresh
- make cell refresh shortcut delay configurable
- cellular refresh shortcuts name customization
- added cellular guards for device calls
- guard uninstall with the cell shortcut switching
- added option to customize the appicon, profile during install
- feature: update profiles management
- feature: added profiles management
- fix: remove the unconditional setting of global cert as custom cert
- fix: extension suffix was dropped
- remove detached task since we are already in detached and a serial prune is fine

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
